description: This pie chart illustrates the proportional distribution of twelve distinct topic categories. The chart does not utilize a separate legend; instead, category labels and their exact percentages are positioned outside the pie and connected to their respective slices via thin grey callout lines. Moving clockwise from the top right, the largest segment is "AI/NLP Research" in dark blue at 24.3%, followed by "Business" in reddish-brown at 5.9%, "Geography" in olive at 2.7%, and "Math" in dark green at 1.2%. Continuing clockwise, the "Game&Anime" slice is shown in orange-brown at 8.2%, "Econ. & Fin." in dark teal at 18.4%, "Science" in greyish-blue at 6.7%, "Law" in muted red at 5.1%, and "History" in brownish-yellow at 8.2%. The final three slices completing the circle are "Med & Health" in muted green at 6.7%, "Pet & Animal" in brown at 5.5%, and "Daily Life" in greyish-teal at 7.1%. The segments do not follow a specific visual ordering, such as ascending or descending size, and none of the slices are visually emphasized, offset, or exploded.
